messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: The Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011 says sixty days and Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008 says forty-five: within how many days of the request must the first periodic verification be carried out today?

Facts:
[0] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]
[1] verifica dopo il termine di quarantacinque giorni — verifiedBy — altri soggetti pubblici o privati abilitati (altri soggetti pubblici o privati abilitati) [condition: Una volta decorso inutilmente il termine di quarantacinque giorni sopra indicato] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[2] prima verifica INAIL — hasTimeLimit — quarantacinque giorni (P45D) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[3] successive verifiche — verifiedBy — ARPA (ARPA) [condition: ove ciò sia previsto con legge regionale] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[4] successive verifiche — verifiedBy — ASL (ASL) [condition: su libera scelta del datore di lavoro] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[5] datore di lavoro, verbali delle verifiche — hasObligation — devono essere conservati e tenuti a disposizione dell'organo di vigilanza (devono essere conservati e tenuti a disposizione dell'organo di vigilanza) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[6] risultati dei controlli di cui al comma 8 — retentionPeriod — ultimi tre anni (P3Y) [condition: almeno quelli relativi agli ultimi tre anni] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 9]
[7] datore di lavoro, costi delle verifiche — hasObligation — le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro (le spese per la loro effettuazione sono poste a carico del datore di lavoro) [condition: Le verifiche di cui al presente comma sono effettuate a titolo oneroso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[8] prima verifica — verifiedBy — INAIL (INAIL) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 11]
[9] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[10] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[11] controlli di cui alle lettere a) e b) — verifiedBy — persona competente (persona competente) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[12] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[13] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo periodici — hasObligation — interventi di controllo periodici (interventi di controllo periodici) [condition: secondo frequenze stabilite in base alle indicazioni fornite dai fabbricanti, ovvero dalle norme di buona tecnica] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[14] This Directive — appliesFrom — 20th day following its publication (20th day following its publication) [DIR, Art. 28]
[15] notified bodies monitoring — verifiedBy — Member States (Member States) [DIR, Art. 14(2)]
[16] original EC declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[17] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[18] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[19] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[20] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[21] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]
[22] datore di lavoro — hasObligation — prende le misure necessarie (prende le misure necessarie) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 4]
[23] datore di lavoro — hasObligation — prende le misure necessarie (prende le misure necessarie) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 6]
[24] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[25] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall use the appropriate verification methods (shall use the appropriate verification methods) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.1]
[26] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[27] notified body — hasObligation — any request for information (any request for information) [REG, Art. 40(1)]
[28] datore di lavoro, controllo iniziale delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio (dopo l'installazione e prima della messa in esercizio) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[29] Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) — appliesFrom — 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14]
[30] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[31] copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[32] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[33] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo straordinari — hasObligation — ogni volta che intervengano eventi eccezionali (ogni volta che intervengano eventi eccezionali) [condition: eventi eccezionali che possano avere conseguenze pregiudizievoli per la sicurezza delle attrezzature di lavoro] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[34] digital instructions, manufacturer — retentionPeriod — make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) [condition: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[35] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[36] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — must use the appropriate verification methods (must use the appropriate verification methods) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.1]
[37] attrezzature di lavoro — mustAccompany — un documento attestante (un documento attestante l'esecuzione dell'ultimo controllo con esito positivo) [condition: Qualora le attrezzature di lavoro di cui al comma 8 siano usate al di fuori della sede dell'unità produttiva] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 10]
[38] registro di controllo delle attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento (siano curati la tenuta e l'aggiornamento) [condition: per cui lo stesso è previsto] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 4]
[39] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]
[40] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]
[41] full reassessment — hasTimeLimit — every three years (P3Y) [DIR, Annex X]
[42] Article 50(1) — appliesFrom — 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12]
[43] Articles 26 to 42 — appliesFrom — 20 January 2024 (2024-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 11]
[44] Article 6(7) and Articles 48 and 52 — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 13]
[45] attrezzature di lavoro — hasObligation — assoggettate alle misure di aggiornamento dei requisiti minimi di sicurezza (assoggettate alle misure di aggiornamento dei requisiti minimi di sicurezza) [condition: stabilite con specifico provvedimento regolamentare] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 4]
[46] tracing log of data generated in relation to an intervention and of safety software versions — retentionPeriod — five years (P5Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[47] dichiarazione autocertificativa su formazione e addestramento — retentionPeriod — per tutta la durata del noleggio (per tutta la durata del noleggio o della concessione) [DLGS72, art. 72, c. 2]
[48] decision to revoke delegation — appliesFrom — the day following the publication (the day following the publication) [condition: or at a later date specified therein] [REG, Art. 47(3)]
[49] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]

response.text: {"kind":"duration","value":"P45D","text":"Under Article 71, comma 11 of Legislative Decree 81/2008, INAIL must carry out the first periodic verification within forty-five days. The facts do not mention the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011's sixty days, so the figure comes only from Article 71. After those 45 days pass without the verification, other qualified public or private bodies can carry it out.","used":[2,1,8]}
